# what is your english level like

## Short answer

Professional working English. I can run a meeting, write
documentation and read a foreign supplier ticket without trouble. I
am not a native speaker, and I say that upfront: I am fluent enough
for the work, and I still lose the subtle, idiomatic jokes.

## Long answer

I started at forty two, one hour a day for nine months, and by
forty six I was defending a full project review in English. I have
used it every day since: the kiln documentation is written in English
and I read support threads from machinery suppliers abroad. The
acceleration practice is the part I would recommend to anyone starting
late.
